Your holdings: SMCI (-28.41%) and SOXL (-67.03%) are deep in the red and need attention. Given your margin use, these drawdowns are amplified and concerning.

Watch: Keep an eye on election results and any major shifts in the semiconductor or broader tech sector sentiment.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most significant losses and respecting your stops.
plays: Trim SMCI: The -28.41% loss and current price below its stop suggest cutting losses here.
Trim SOXL: The -67.03% loss and leveraged nature make this a prime candidate for trimming.
Consider SOXS: The scanner shows a potential short setup (entry 51.55-51.19, stop 50.18) if the semiconductor downturn continues.
